The R5 source validates each original FIT event; child risk learner updates AFTER original R5 accepts. Real-time selected Feedback also trains child. Neither path can label unselected actions or current protected episodes as FIT.
allowed: r8.ObserveFit delegates exact source-approved FIT record to original r5.ObserveFit before updating source-public context turn risk counters; previous action category resets on terminal FIT event. Separate future episodes also persist conditional statistics, not private source-specific coordinates.
prohibited: Unit fixtures authored as PublicGrid are engineering only; no claim they are authentic source interactions. No original dev/holdout conversion; no source runner, new world, native R5 mutation beyond already authorized FIT semantics; no prospectively qualified benefit.
required: tests must demonstrate actual ObserveFit and Choose changes while same raw public decision input and fully independent conventional Beta reference ties; must also prove rejected FIT leaves child unchanged, Feedback conserves source actions, cold restart model, original R5 checkpoint unchanged
